finite_ratio_warnings.finite_a2_over_a0: This is a finite-factor moment ratio. It should not be read as the pure K3 A2/A0 ratio, since Ricci-flat K3 has A2=0.
finite_ratio_warnings.product_C2: When A2=0, C2=-A0*F2. Thus the finite mass moment fills the Lambda^2 slot of the product heat trace.
finite_ratio_warnings.product_C4: When A2=0, C4=A4*N + A0*F4/2. The Lambda^0 slot mixes the topological/curvature K3 coefficient with the finite F4 moment.
